What people say
An excellent school. A culture of challenge and high expectations but with plenty of support to help learners achieve their potential.
Newstead is an amazing place to study and grow as a person. The community feel to Newstead makes it stand out as an exceptional school.
We continue to be delighted by our child's education at Newstead. She speaks very positively about her teachers and their support.
I love every part of this school. My friends are extremely supportive and the teachers are always so passionate about their subjects
